name: Goldilocks VIX band (between) + risk-on macro arms RSI-oversold reversion
rationale: THESIS: reversion edge is non-monotonic in vol — too calm means no dislocation to harvest, too panicked means regime break. The sweet spot is a MIDDLE vix band (between a fitted lo and hi) where dislocations are real but the regime is intact, AND macro_regime is risk-on. RSI-oversold is the trigger. Using vix between (not lt/gt) is the structural novelty vs the calm-only and panic-only siblings. DISCONFIRMER 1 (is the band real, or is one edge doing all the work?): two siblings — vix lt-only (calm) and vix gt-only (panic) — bracket this; if either single-sided cut matches the band, the 'band' is a relabelled one-sided cut. DISCONFIRMER 2 (just buy-the-dip?): bare RSI-oversold ungated baseline. DISCONFIRMER 3 (macro active?): drop macro_regime, keep the vix band. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout): frozen-param recent slice positive.
catalyst: vix_level inside a fitted moderate band AND macro_regime risk-on with RSI oversold
